tools.name: search_styles
tools.description: Searches the public AIKIZI gallery of decoded images (AI style analyses) by words such as a style, subject, mood or color. Returns up to 20 published items with title, style, subject, mood, a small preview image and the aikizi.com link. Read-only; no sign-in needed. Example: {"query": "neon noir por

tools.name: get_style_decode
tools.description: Gets the style breakdown of one published AIKIZI decode: title, styles, style DNA, subjects, moods, key tokens, color hues, the generation prompt, a small preview image and the aikizi.com link. Takes the id from search_styles or an aikizi.com/decode/<id> link. Read-only; no sign-in needed. Example:

tools.name: check_balance
tools.description: Shows how many AIKIZI credits the connected account has. Example: {}.

tools.name: decode_image
tools.description: Runs AIKIZI’s style decode on one image the person gives you by its public https link (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB): subjects, styles, style DNA, moods, key tokens and a generation prompt. Uses the connected account’s AIKIZI credits (given back if the decode fails) and saves the decode privately

tools.name: check_job_status
tools.description: Says whether one of the connected account’s decodes is pending, processing, completed or failed. Use it after decode_image answered "still running". Example: {"decode_id": "bc2be49a-ef44-417e-9015-4923febd46ae"}.

tools.name: get_my_decode
tools.description: Gets the style breakdown of a decode in the connected account’s AIKIZI library, published or private: title, styles, style DNA, subjects, moods, key tokens, the prompt and the aikizi.com link. Example: {"decode_id": "bc2be49a-ef44-417e-9015-4923febd46ae"}.

tools.name: list_my_creations
tools.description: Lists the newest items in the connected account’s AIKIZI library: image, video and audio decodes and generated images, videos and audio, with id, kind, title, status, date and the aikizi.com link. Example: {"type": "image", "limit": 10}.

tools.name: get_creation
tools.description: Gets one image the connected account generated on AIKIZI: prompt, model, aspect ratio, size, credits it cost, date, a small preview and the aikizi.com link. Example: {"creation_id": "5f0c1e8a-3a51-4d7e-9a57-1c2b3d4e5f60"}.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generates one image from a text prompt on AIKIZI and saves it in the connected account’s library. Uses the connected account’s AIKIZI credits (given back if generation fails); nano-banana-2-lite makes 1K only. Example: {"prompt": "a lighthouse on a cliff at dusk, painterly", "aspect_ratio": "16:9"}.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "decode_image" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Runs AIKIZI’s style decode on one image the person gives you by its public https link (JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 10 MB): subjects, styles, style DNA, moods, key tokens and a generation prompt. Uses the connected account’s AIKIZI credits (given back if the decode fails) and saves the decode privately " → after: "Runs AIKIZI’s style decode on one image: subjects, styles, style DNA, moods, key tokens and a generation prompt. Give exactly one of image_url (a public https link to a JPEG, PNG or WebP up to 10 MB) or image_id (an image the person added with add_image). An image attached to the chat cannot reach A"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_image" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
